context.task_title: Verify ML metrics collection fix works end-to-end

data.instructions:
Verify ML metrics collection fix works end-to-end:

1. MERGE FIRST: 
   git checkout main && git pull origin main
   git merge origin/claude/investigate-metrics-collection-VQKg4

2. VERIFY HOOKS CONFIGURED:
   cat ~/.claude/settings.json
   Should have SessionStart, PostToolUse, Stop hooks with 'cwd:Opus-code-test' matcher

3. CHECK BASELINE:
   python scripts/ml_data_collector.py stats
   Note current counts (especially Sessions and Chats)

4. VERIFY SESSION CAPTURE:
   - SessionStart hook should show ML banner at session start
   - Work normally during session
   - End session cleanly (commit and push all changes)
   - Next session check: tail -5 .git-ml/tracked/sessions.jsonl
   - Should have new entry with current timestamp

5. VERIFY TEST ISOLATION:
   python -m pytest tests/unit/test_experiment_manager.py::test_file_prediction_experiment_get_metric_history -v
   wc -l .git-ml/metrics/metrics.jsonl
   Should still be 10 lines (no pollution)

6. REPORT RESULTS:
   Complete task T-20260103-084232-6c64eef4 with verification results

Reference: KT-20260103-084006 (ML Metrics Collection Fix)

result.message: Verification complete. Test isolation fix is working. Hook configuration needs attention - see task retrospective.
